messages:
maya: kicking off canary for model v4.0-int4 at 8% traffic. baseline is v3.8-fp32. main ask: agree on deferred rollback windows and slice-level parity gates.
claire: early sims look promising on throughput (-31% tokens/$) and p95 latency, but doc-qa slices show precision dip ~0.9%. small but visible.
ev an: infra: int4 coldstart warms KV slower; we saw steady-state after ~40m. throughput variance during warmup.
rohit: suggestion: add a warmup hold to disable auto-rollback for first 40m, but still emit alerts. otherwise we trigger on benign warmstart noise.
sam: ops +1. also recommend hysteresis: require 4 consecutive 5m windows beyond threshold before automatic rollback. keep immediate manual rollback option.
maya: proposing slice-aware policy: critical slices (auth flows, billing) use 0.5% rel MRR threshold, other slices 1.0%. global hallucination cap 0.7% abs. require sample floor n>=120 for any auto action.
claire: sounds good. also propose "tighten after" behavior: after 90m reduce thresholds by 20% to catch slow drifts.
ev an: note on routing: prefer stepdown rollback 60%->30%->0 over 3 minutes to avoid queue spikes. ensure backfill uses pinned fp32 variant.
rohit: implementability: we'll expose two flags on canary config: warmup_mins and hysteresis_windows. example config snippet below (string only):
```json
{"warmup_mins":"40","hysteresis_windows":"4","window_mins":"5","critical_rel_mrr":"0.005","default_rel_mrr":"0.01","abs_hall":"0.007","sample_floor":"120","tighten_after_mins":"90","tighten_factor":"0.8"}
```
claire: minor tweak: lower default_rel_mrr to 0.009 to reduce false negatives.
sam: ops: set alert channel #canary-ops for immediate visibility; mute noisy non-critical slices by default.
maya: agreed. action items: Rohit add warmup + stepdown rollback logic; Evan verify pinned-fp32 backfill route; Claire finalize slice list and thresholds; Sam configure alerts. meet back in 2h for smoke check. :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary started at 4898765432 -> 8% traffic. health checks nominal. dashboard: https://console/redwood/canary/4898765432
